Identified as this saint because: Found by route 3: ru.wikipedia's «Иннокентий (Охлябинин)» carries Q4201207, whose P18 is this file. Its own title, «Иннокентий Комельский», is the folder's stored Russian form less the second epithet — the folder stores «Иннокентий Комельский, Вологодский» — and Commons files it under `Category:Saints of Vologda`, which is that second epithet. Commons dates it «Икона. XVII век», a seventeenth-century icon. This folder is Innokenty Okhlyabinin, the disciple of Nilus of Sora who founded the house on the Nurma, kept 19 March in the Greek and Russian calendars. A single-figure icon, but SMALL: 388x600, so the long edge is only just over the floor and the short edge is under the 450 px of erasmus-of-the-kyiv-caves. Item 15 should replace it if a larger one appears. Route 2 reported no Wikidata hit for him, because the entity's label is the name in brackets form. Commons describes it: Икона. XVII век
